dedupe_keys.name: atom geo ide developpement durable gouv fr drinking water datasets

description: atom.geo-ide.developpement-durable.gouv.fr: drinking water datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by atom.geo-ide.developpement-durable.gouv.fr. Coverage: the area served by atom.geo-ide.developpement-durable.gouv.fr. The listing groups 28 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about drinking water; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Collectivité compétente en eau potable par commune en Corrèze; Nouvelle-Aquitaine : Communes concernées par une canalisation de trans; Nouvelle-Aquitaine partiel : Canalisations de transport et de distribu; Maitrise de l’urbanisme : contraintes en cours de connaissance induite. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
